target.title: fix(openclaw): harden smoke lock staging and identity
target.body:
## Summary

- keep smoke-lock commit staging claim-local and reject escaped or replaced commit paths
- add backward-compatible sub-second Darwin process identities and cache successful local identity reads
- preserve owner-only trust boundaries and expand smoke-lock race and cleanup coverage

## Validation

- `pnpm exec vitest run test/openclaw-smoke-lock.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1` (53 passed)
- `pnpm exec vitest run test/openclaw.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1 -t "owns complete artifact publication and releases only after the generation is installed|rejects cross-process smoke runs that share an output artifact set"` (2 passed)
- `pnpm lint`
- `git diff --check 32b2c0992f88195f1a41d22adedf00c3f58a242f...c74367ff9aa4e7165b5dbbef05a73ad9a284e989`
- privacy scan of changed paths and patch
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main --engine codex --model gpt-5.6-sol --thinking high --stream-engine-output` (clean, no accepted findings)

## Review state

Exact reviewed pair: base `32b2c0992f88195f1a41d22adedf00c3f58a242f`, head `c74367ff9aa4e7165b5dbbef05a73ad9a284e989`.

`origin/main` advanced to `09064808fdd839fff301b9dc1d363ee7ccc1b421` immediately after the clean exact-head review. GitHub currently reports `DIRTY`; the overlap is the newest Unreleased `CHANGELOG.md` insertion. This PR stays draft for the separate landing queue to rebase, preserve every Unreleased entry, and refresh exact-head proof. Do not merge from this state.
